Question
What are the names and id of courses having less than 2 sections?

output.sql:
SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name
FROM Courses AS c
JOIN Sections AS s ON s.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
HAVING COUNT(s.section_id) < 2;
